mainEntity.name: Do I need to download or install Zhuzhiliao?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The page has no build step or dependencies — just open it in a browser. The main page can also be saved and opened offline.

mainEntity.name: Why is there no sound the first time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Browsers usually require a user click or touch before playing sound; tap the page or “Tap to enable sound” to unlock it.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I use the Shake Phone mode?

acceptedAnswer.text: This mode relies on motion sensors, requires HTTPS or a local file, and iPhone may need permission on first use.

mainEntity.name: What kind of toy is Zhuzhiliao?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zhuzhiliao is a traditional Chinese folk toy, also known regionally as Bamboo Cicada or pull-string cicada. A bamboo tube is covered with a membrane; a rosin-coated string ties the membrane center to a small bamboo stick. When you hold the stick and swing it in circles, the string stick-slips on the rosin, vibrating the membrane, and the bamboo cavity amplifies it into a cicada-like “wah-wah” sound.

“Cyber Zhuzhiliao” is the nickname for this kind of web simulation: instead of buying a real bamboo toy, you press and spin in the browser to hear the exact same “wah-wah” sound, taken from real Zhuzhiliao recordings.
Completely free, no ads, no in-app purchases, no registration. The code is open source on GitHub (imsai-sh/zhuzhiliao).

mainEntity.name: Is the sound synthesized or a real recording?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main source is a real Zhuzhiliao recording sample, embedded in the page as a seamless loop, with playback rate driven by spin speed; only when the sample fails to decode does it fall back to Web Audio synthesis.
Yes. A Service Worker caches core resources, and you can install it to the desktop as a PWA; saving index.html locally and opening it in a browser works too.

Only anonymous site-wide wah counts, visits, and online users are counted; your personal wah count is stored only in the browser localStorage, with no login or personal identity information collected.
